"""R21 finite adapter; immutable prior supervisor and raw reconstruction."""

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
_path = HERE.parent / "r20/env_contract.py"
if (
    hashlib.sha256(_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    != "b347e161a7c3a255c4bb2efeda3eff2bd6df5e0f12f72739d3d204a46418859c"
):
    raise ValueError("immutable R20 gate drift")
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("r21_frozen_r20", _path)
old = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(old)
prior = old.prior
require, digest, ROOT = prior.require, prior.digest, prior.ROOT
AREA = "v2/experiments/action_executor/r21"
DATABASES = ("rtr_tip054_r21_local_e1", "rtr_tip054_r21_engine_e1")
DSN = "postgresql://rtr_app:rtr_tip054_synthetic_only@tip054-pg:5432/" + DATABASES[0]
WORKFLOW = "postgresql://rtr_tip054_engine:rtr_tip054_synthetic_only@tip054-pg:5432/" + DATABASES[1]
R20_BINDING = "v2/experiments/action_executor/r20/source-binding-e4.json"
R20_SHA = "9ee11e8257402c9038abcc8d07d5b4e3d9a09efa146a1e62b2f52702a65333ae"
SEAL = "v2/experiments/action_executor/r20/main-evidence-binding.sha256"
SEAL_SHA = "f8c3f11790ec4c624845e8151c0ee9beebb709b26d00acdef2f732ca011fb1af"
NAMES = tuple(
    sorted(
        (
            "test_exact_caller_and_derived_envelopes_before_effects",
            "test_linked_source_history_and_one_use_admission",
            "test_original_rows_order_missing_and_quantile_conservation",
            "test_packet_summary_controls_oracle_and_corruption",
            "test_supervisor_dispatch_and_shell_ownership_failclosed",
            "test_fixture_db_closure_and_readiness_scope",
        )
    )
)
GROUPS = {
    "offline": ["/work/r21/test_r21_offline.py::R21Controls::" + name for name in NAMES],
    "envelope": ["/work/r21/test_r21_envelope.py::test_captured_load_envelope_without_sql"],
}
FILES = (
    "qualification.py",
    "test_r21_offline.py",
    "test_r21_envelope.py",
    "run-http-qualification.sh",
    "contract.json",
)
EXTRAS = (
    "vibecode_v2/R21_SCAN_DESIGN.md",
    "vibecode_v2/TIP-054.4b-R21_MANDATORY_OFF_QUALIFICATION.md",
    "vibecode_v2/TIP-054.4b-R20_VERIFY_REPORT.md",
    "vibecode_v2/TIP-054.4b-R20_FINAL_RESULT_REVIEW.md",
    "v2/experiments/action_executor/r20/main-final-closure.json",
    "v2/experiments/action_executor/r20/main-bootstrap-closure.json",
    R20_BINDING,
    SEAL,
)
PROFILE = {
    "runner_cpus": 4,
    "runner_memory_gib": 4,
    "postgres_cpus": 2,
    "postgres_memory_mib": 4096,
    "postgres_data_tmpfs_gib": 3,
    "samples_per_operation_load": 100,
    "corpus": "one permitted signed synthetic SOT reference",
    "auth": "synthetic current subject dependency only; real API middleware/router/policy/domain paths",
    "rate_limits_enabled": True,
    "finite_test_window_render_quota": 5000,
    "finite_test_window_read_quota": 5000,
    "rate_window_seconds": 60,
    "no_worker": True,
    "no_provider": True,
    "recorder": "per_observation_host_backed_JSONL_append_flush_final_JSON",
}
LIMITS = (
    "Request service time includes pool contention while an acquired case slot is held; "
    "semaphore queue excluded. Declared finite synthetic rate quotas cover burst samples, "
    "not serving default30 writes/120reads per minute certification. Local ASGI not "
    "network/UI/mobile/OIDC latency, provider/render time or production load certification."
)
CONTROLS = {
    "observer": "off",
    "pool_size": 5,
    "max_overflow": 5,
    "pre_ping": True,
    "operation_timeout_seconds": 0.9,
    "old_load_helper": "/work/latency_probe.py",
    "provider": False,
    "worker": False,
    "authority_override": "Existing current synthetic subject dependency ONLY",
}


def caller(mapping):
    for key, value in (
        ("POSTGRES_DSN", DSN),
        ("INTEGRATION_DATABASE_DSN", DSN),
        ("ACTION_WORKFLOW_DSN", WORKFLOW),
    ):
        require(
            type(mapping.get(key)) is str and mapping[key] == value, "exact explicit caller " + key
        )


def environment(mapping, mode):
    require(mode in {"pre", "load"}, "finite envelope")
    for key in ("POSTGRES_DSN", "INTEGRATION_DATABASE_DSN"):
        require(mapping.get(key) == DSN, "captured domain " + key)
    fixed = {
        "ACTION_EXECUTOR_ENABLED": "true" if mode == "load" else "false",
        "RAG_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER": "offline",
        "RAG_PROVIDER_MODE": "local",
        "OPENAI_API_KEY": "",
        "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "",
        "LIMITS_RATE_RENDER_MAX": "5000" if mode == "load" else "30",
        "LIMITS_RATE_DEFAULT_READ_MAX": "5000" if mode == "load" else "120",
        "LIMITS_RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS": "60",
        "ACTION_EXECUTOR_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS": "0.9",
    }
    require(
        all(mapping.get(key) == value for key, value in fixed.items()),
        "exact " + mode + " envelope",
    )
    require(
        mapping.get("ACTION_WORKFLOW_DSN") == WORKFLOW
        if mode == "load"
        else "ACTION_WORKFLOW_DSN" not in mapping,
        "workflow envelope",
    )


def envelopes(mapping):
    caller(mapping)
    base = dict(mapping)
    base.pop("ACTION_WORKFLOW_DSN")
    base.update(
        ACTION_EXECUTOR_ENABLED="false",
        LIMITS_RATE_RENDER_MAX="30",
        LIMITS_RATE_DEFAULT_READ_MAX="120",
    )
    environment(base, "pre")
    base.update(
        ACTION_EXECUTOR_ENABLED="true",
        ACTION_WORKFLOW_DSN=WORKFLOW,
        LIMITS_RATE_RENDER_MAX="5000",
        LIMITS_RATE_DEFAULT_READ_MAX="5000",
    )
    environment(base, "load")


def selectors(group="all"):
    require(group in {*GROUPS, "all"}, "finite selection")
    return sum(GROUPS.values(), []) if group == "all" else GROUPS[group]


def wanted_contract():
    return {
        "schema": "R21-one-shot-OFF-v1",
        "http": prior.load_json(prior.HERE.parent / "r18/qualification.json")["http"],
        "databases": list(DATABASES),
        "groups": GROUPS,
        "roots": {"pre": "/evidence/r19/r21_pre_e1", "http": "/evidence/r19/r21_http_e1"},
        "product_digest": prior.PRODUCT,
        "test_digest": prior.TESTS,
        "candidate": "NOT_READY",
        "serving_executor": "OFF",
        "tip054_5": "BLOCKED",
        "source_packet_bytes": 1048576,
    }


def contract(path=HERE / "contract.json"):
    require(Path(path).stat().st_size <= 65536, "contract cap")
    result = prior.load_json(path)
    require(
        json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(wanted_contract(), sort_keys=True),
        "exact R21 contract",
    )
    return result


def snapshot():
    require(digest(prior.r18.content(ROOT, R20_BINDING)) == R20_SHA, "R20 source seal")
    old.source(ROOT / R20_BINDING)
    seal = prior.r18.content(ROOT, SEAL)
    require(
        digest(seal) == SEAL_SHA and len(seal.decode().splitlines()) == 202, "R20 evidence seal"
    )
    for line in seal.decode().splitlines():
        sha, path = line.split("  ", 1)
        require(digest(prior.r18.content(ROOT, path)) == sha, "protected R20 drift: " + path)
    paths = (*EXTRAS, *(AREA + "/" + name for name in FILES))
    return {
        "schema": "R21-linked-source-v1",
        "prior_source_sha256": R20_SHA,
        "prior_evidence_sha256": SEAL_SHA,
        "digests": {"product": prior.PRODUCT, "tests": prior.TESTS},
        "files": {path: digest(prior.r18.content(ROOT, path)) for path in sorted(paths)},
    }


def source(path):
    require(prior.load_json(path) == snapshot(), "source/preservation drift")
    require(
        Path(path).stat().st_size + sum((HERE / name).stat().st_size for name in FILES) <= 1048576,
        "source packet cap",
    )


def collection(path):
    require(
        prior.r18.collected(path) == [prior.r18.normalized_nodeid(node) for node in selectors()],
        "exact seven IDs",
    )


def marker(binding):
    return {
        "epoch": "r21_http_e1",
        "binding_sha256": digest(Path(binding).read_bytes()),
        "contract_sha256": digest((HERE / "contract.json").read_bytes()),
        "consumed": True,
        "meaning": "created immediately before spawn; unknown launch consumed",
    }


def mark(path, binding):
    with Path(path).open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(marker(binding), stream, sort_keys=True)
        stream.flush()


def exact(left, right):
    return json.dumps(left, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) == json.dumps(
        right, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False
    )


def journal_rows(root):
    raw = (Path(root) / "run/samples.jsonl").read_bytes()
    require(not raw or raw.endswith(b"\n"), "partial journal; no repair")
    return [
        json.loads(line, parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(value)))
        for line in raw.decode().splitlines()
    ]


def packet(root):
    root = Path(root)
    require(
        exact(
            prior.load_json(root.parent / "r21-campaign-launch.json"), marker(root / "binding.json")
        ),
        "new consumed campaign/source identity",
    )
    require(
        (root / "contract.json").read_bytes() == (HERE / "contract.json").read_bytes(),
        "retained contract identity",
    )
    rows = journal_rows(root)
    require(
        exact(rows, prior.load_json(root / "run/samples.json")), "JSON/JSONL exact list equality"
    )
    result = prior.reconstruct(rows)
    summary = prior.load_json(root / "run/latency-summary.json")
    require(
        exact(
            summary,
            {
                "status": result["status"],
                "cells": result["cells"],
                "profile": PROFILE,
                "limits": LIMITS,
            },
        ),
        "full original summary/profile/oracle agreement",
    )
    require(exact(prior.load_json(root / "run/r-controls.json"), CONTROLS), "original OFF controls")
    process = prior.r18.child_record(
        root / "load.process.json", prior.load_json(root / "load.process.json")["exit_code"]
    )
    code = 0 if result["status"] == "PASS" else 1
    require(
        type(process["exit_code"]) is int and type(process["original_exit_code"]) is int,
        "typed original driver exit",
    )
    require(
        process["reason"] == "completed"
        and process["exit_code"] == process["original_exit_code"] == code,
        "completed original driver/oracle exit",
    )
    result.update(integrity="PASS", oracle_complete_pass=code == 0)
    return result


def analyze(root):
    try:
        return packet(root)
    except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError, TypeError, UnicodeError) as error:
        # Retain identity/missing counts for valid partial rows; never salvage a PASS.
        result = {"requested": 1600}
        try:
            result.update(prior.reconstruct(journal_rows(root)))
            result["population_origin"] = "valid whole journal only; packet integrity still FAIL"
        except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError, TypeError, UnicodeError):
            pass
        result.update(
            integrity="FAIL", status="FAIL", error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error)
        )
        return result


def passing_pre(root, binding):
    root = Path(root)
    require((root / "binding.json").read_bytes() == Path(binding).read_bytes(), "same binding PRE")
    require(
        (root / "contract.json").read_bytes() == (HERE / "contract.json").read_bytes(),
        "same PRE contract",
    )
    collection(root / "collection.stdout.txt")
    codes = (root / "returncodes.txt").read_text().splitlines()
    for label in (
        "syntax",
        "pins",
        "ruff",
        "format",
        "collection",
        "inventory",
        "offline",
        "offline-xml",
        "envelope",
        "envelope-xml",
    ):
        require(codes.count(label + " 0") == 1, "passing PRE child " + label)
        require(
            prior.r18.child_record(root / f"{label}.process.json", 0)["reason"] == "completed",
            "PRE completed",
        )
    require(codes.count("stage pre exit 0") == 1, "passing PRE stage")
    for group in GROUPS:
        prior.r18.junit(root / (group + ".xml"), selectors(group))
    prior.cap(root, "pre")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    command, *args = sys.argv[1:]
    if command == "snapshot":
        print(json.dumps(snapshot(), indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        sys.exit(0)
    contract()
    if command == "environment":
        envelopes(os.environ)
    elif command == "source":
        source(args[0])
    elif command == "selectors":
        print("\n".join(selectors(*args)))
        sys.exit(0)
    elif command == "collection":
        collection(*args)
    elif command == "xml":
        prior.r18.junit(args[0], selectors(args[1]))
    elif command == "fixture":
        prior.r18.fixture(*args)
    elif command == "cap":
        print(prior.cap(*args))
    elif command == "child":
        prior.r18.child_record(*args)
    elif command == "drained":
        prior.r18.child_record(args[0], prior.load_json(args[0])["exit_code"])
    elif command == "prior":
        passing_pre(*args)
    elif command == "mark":
        mark(*args)
    elif command == "analyze":
        result = analyze(args[0])
        print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
        sys.exit(0 if result["integrity"] == result["status"] == "PASS" else 1)
    elif command == "review":
        require(
            digest(Path(args[0]).read_bytes()) == args[1]
            and "SOURCE ACCEPTED" in Path(args[0]).read_text(),
            "accepted pinned review",
        )
    else:
        raise ValueError("unknown finite gate")
    print("R21_PASS", command)

"""Six finite stdlib controls; no product imports, SQL, Docker or signals."""

import copy
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import qualification as gate


class R21Controls(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="codex-tmp-r21-controls-20261009-")
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        self.env = dict(
            POSTGRES_DSN=gate.DSN,
            INTEGRATION_DATABASE_DSN=gate.DSN,
            ACTION_WORKFLOW_DSN=gate.WORKFLOW,
            ACTION_EXECUTOR_ENABLED="true",
            RAG_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER="offline",
            RAG_PROVIDER_MODE="local",
            OPENAI_API_KEY="",
            ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="",
            LIMITS_RATE_RENDER_MAX="5000",
            LIMITS_RATE_DEFAULT_READ_MAX="5000",
            LIMITS_RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS="60",
            ACTION_EXECUTOR_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS="0.9",
        )

    def rows(self):
        return [
            dict(
                profile=p,
                case=c,
                operation=o,
                elapsed_ms=1.0,
                okay=True,
                http_status=gate.prior.STATUS[o],
                state=gate.prior.STATES[o],
                error_code=None,
            )
            for p, c, o in gate.prior.expected()
        ]

    def write_packet(self, rows=None, code=0):
        root = self.root / "r21_http_e1"
        (root / "run").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (root / "binding.json").write_text('{"fixed":"source"}')
        (root / "contract.json").write_bytes((gate.HERE / "contract.json").read_bytes())
        marker = self.root / "r21-campaign-launch.json"
        marker.write_text(json.dumps(gate.marker(root / "binding.json")))
        rows = self.rows() if rows is None else rows
        (root / "run/samples.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows))
        (root / "run/samples.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps(row) + "\n" for row in rows))
        result = gate.prior.reconstruct(rows)
        (root / "run/latency-summary.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(
                dict(
                    status=result["status"],
                    cells=result["cells"],
                    profile=gate.PROFILE,
                    limits=gate.LIMITS,
                )
            )
        )
        (root / "run/r-controls.json").write_text(json.dumps(gate.CONTROLS))
        owner = {"group": 123, "token": "owned", "cleanup_deadline": None}
        (root / "load.owner.json").write_text(json.dumps(owner))
        (root / "load.process.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(
                dict(
                    owner=owner,
                    exit_code=code,
                    original_exit_code=code,
                    reason="completed",
                    group_drained=True,
                )
            )
        )
        return root

    def test_exact_caller_and_derived_envelopes_before_effects(self):
        gate.envelopes(self.env)
        for key in ("POSTGRES_DSN", "INTEGRATION_DATABASE_DSN", "ACTION_WORKFLOW_DSN"):
            for value in (
                None,
                "",
                "foreign",
                self.env[key] + "?sslmode=require",
                self.env[key] + "#x",
            ):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    gate.envelopes(dict(self.env, **{key: value}))
            missing = dict(self.env)
            del missing[key]
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                gate.envelopes(missing)
        pre = dict(
            self.env,
            ACTION_EXECUTOR_ENABLED="false",
            LIMITS_RATE_RENDER_MAX="30",
            LIMITS_RATE_DEFAULT_READ_MAX="120",
        )
        del pre["ACTION_WORKFLOW_DSN"]
        gate.environment(pre, "pre")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            gate.environment(dict(pre, ACTION_WORKFLOW_DSN=""), "pre")
        shell = (gate.HERE / "run-http-qualification.sh").read_text().split("\nmkdir -p", 1)[0]
        shell = shell.replace(
            'evidence="$raw/r21_${stage}_e1"', 'evidence="$CASE_ROOT/never-created"'
        )
        setup = 'python3() { return 0; }; command() { printf "%s\\n" "$REAL_PYTHON"; };\n'
        base = dict(
            R21_MAIN_ADMISSION="pre",
            R21_SOURCE_REVIEW="unused",
            R21_SOURCE_REVIEW_SHA256="unused",
            REAL_PYTHON=sys.executable,
            CASE_ROOT=str(self.root),
        )
        for supplied, expected in (
            ({}, False),
            ({"POSTGRES_DSN": gate.DSN}, False),
            (dict(self.env, INTEGRATION_DATABASE_DSN="foreign"), False),
            (dict(self.env, ACTION_WORKFLOW_DSN=gate.DSN), False),
            (self.env, True),
        ):
            result = subprocess.run(
                [
                    "/bin/bash",
                    "-c",
                    setup + shell + "\necho EFFECT_ENTERED\n",
                    str(gate.HERE / "run-http-qualification.sh"),
                    "pre",
                    "source-binding-e1.json",
                ],
                env={**base, **supplied},
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=5,
            )
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode == 0, expected, result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual("EFFECT_ENTERED" in result.stdout, expected)

    def test_linked_source_history_and_one_use_admission(self):
        path = self.root / "binding.json"
        path.write_text("{}")
        with (
            patch.object(gate, "snapshot", return_value={"different": True}),
            self.assertRaises(ValueError),
        ):
            gate.source(path)
        marker = self.root / "marker.json"
        gate.mark(marker, path)
        before = marker.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
            gate.mark(marker, path)
        self.assertEqual(marker.read_bytes(), before)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(before)["epoch"], "r21_http_e1")
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.R20_SHA, "9ee11e8257402c9038abcc8d07d5b4e3d9a09efa146a1e62b2f52702a65333ae"
        )
        old_marker = gate.prior.r18.content(gate.ROOT, gate.prior.RAW + "/campaign-launch.json")
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.digest(old_marker),
            "bd5d22631a2613859f0611a98778e69c4fbbe207f4b44254a46ac19c7f3f5c9b",
        )

    def test_original_rows_order_missing_and_quantile_conservation(self):
        rows = self.rows()
        full = gate.prior.reconstruct(rows)
        self.assertEqual(
            (full["observed"], full["missing_count"], len(full["cells"])), (1600, 0, 16)
        )
        self.assertEqual(gate.prior.quantile(list(range(1, 101)), 0.95), 95)
        partial = gate.prior.reconstruct(rows[:4])
        self.assertEqual(partial["observed"] + partial["missing_count"], 1600)
        for key, value in (
            ("profile", True),
            ("case", False),
            ("elapsed_ms", float("nan")),
            ("state", "wrong"),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                gate.prior.row_key(dict(rows[0], **{key: value}))
        for invalid in (
            rows + [rows[0]],
            [rows[1]],
            [rows[0], rows[0]],
            [rows[0], rows[3]],
            list(reversed(rows[:4])),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                gate.prior.reconstruct(invalid)
        slow = copy.deepcopy(rows)
        for row in slow:
            if row["operation"] == "admission":
                row["elapsed_ms"] = 501
        self.assertEqual(gate.prior.reconstruct(slow)["status"], "FAIL")

    def test_packet_summary_controls_oracle_and_corruption(self):
        root = self.write_packet()
        self.assertEqual(gate.packet(root)["status"], "PASS")
        for target, change in (
            ("run/latency-summary.json", lambda data: data["profile"].update(no_worker=False)),
            ("run/r-controls.json", lambda data: data.update(observer="on")),
            ("run/r-controls.json", lambda data: data.update(pre_ping=1)),
            ("run/latency-summary.json", lambda data: data["cells"][0].update(samples=100.0)),
            ("../r21-campaign-launch.json", lambda data: data.update(consumed=1)),
            ("load.process.json", lambda data: data.update(original_exit_code=1)),
            (
                "load.process.json",
                lambda data: data.update(exit_code=False, original_exit_code=False),
            ),
            ("load.owner.json", lambda data: data.update(token="foreign")),
        ):
            path = root / target
            saved = path.read_bytes()
            data = json.loads(saved)
            change(data)
            path.write_text(json.dumps(data))
            self.assertEqual(gate.analyze(root)["integrity"], "FAIL")
            path.write_bytes(saved)
        journal = root / "run/samples.jsonl"
        journal.write_bytes(journal.read_bytes().rstrip(b"\n"))
        invalid = gate.analyze(root)
        self.assertEqual(invalid["integrity"], "FAIL")
        self.assertNotIn("observed", invalid)
        root = self.write_packet(self.rows()[:4], code=1)
        self.assertEqual(gate.packet(root)["status"], "FAIL")
        (root / "run/latency-summary.json").unlink()
        result = gate.analyze(root)
        self.assertEqual(
            (result["integrity"], result["observed"], result["missing_count"]), ("FAIL", 4, 1596)
        )

    def test_supervisor_dispatch_and_shell_ownership_failclosed(self):
        supervisor = (gate.HERE.parent / "r19/bounded.py").read_text()
        self.assertIn('stage == "http" and label == "load"', supervisor)
        self.assertIn('owner["cleanup_deadline"] = deadline', supervisor)
        self.assertNotIn("bounded.py", gate.FILES)
        shell = (gate.HERE / "run-http-qualification.sh").read_text()
        stop = "stop_active() {" + shell.split("stop_active() {", 1)[1].split("\ncleanup() {", 1)[0]
        cleanup = "cleanup() {" + shell.split("cleanup() {", 1)[1].split("\ncapacity() {", 1)[0]
        setup = """set -euo pipefail
evidence=$1
container_evidence=/evidence/r19/r21_http_e1
r21_dir=unused
active_pid=123
active_label=load
owned_databases=(rtr_tip054_r21_local_e1 rtr_tip054_r21_engine_e1)
owned_count=2
uncertain_database=$4
stop_code=$2
proof_code=$3
exec_runner() { return "$stop_code"; }
python3() { return "$proof_code"; }
kill() { return 1; }
wait() { return 0; }
pg_sql() { printf '%s\\n' "$*" >> "$evidence/drops"; }
absence() { echo 0; }
"""
        for stop_code, proof_code, uncertain, expected in (
            (1, 0, "", False),
            (0, 1, "", False),
            (0, 0, "unknown", False),
            (0, 0, "", True),
        ):
            drop = self.root / "drops"
            drop.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            result = subprocess.run(
                [
                    "/bin/bash",
                    "-c",
                    setup
                    + stop
                    + "\n"
                    + cleanup
                    + '\nif ! stop_active; then echo "HELD:$active_pid:$owned_count"; exit 1; fi\ncleanup\n',
                    "control",
                    str(self.root),
                    str(stop_code),
                    str(proof_code),
                    uncertain,
                ],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=5,
            )
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0 if expected else 1, result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(drop.exists(), expected)
            if expected:
                self.assertEqual(
                    [line.split("DROP DATABASE ")[1] for line in drop.read_text().splitlines()],
                    ['"rtr_tip054_r21_engine_e1";', '"rtr_tip054_r21_local_e1";'],
                )
            elif stop_code or proof_code:
                self.assertIn("HELD:123:2", result.stdout)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            gate.prior.r18.safe_path(self.root, "../foreign")

    def test_fixture_db_closure_and_readiness_scope(self):
        packet = gate.contract()
        self.assertEqual(

        tree = ET.Element("testsuites")

        for node in gate.selectors():

        ET.SubElement(suite[0], "skipped")

"""Fresh intended-load Settings capture and cold pool; no SQL or driver import."""

import os

import pytest
from qualification import DSN, WORKFLOW, environment


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_captured_load_envelope_without_sql(tmp_path):
    environment(os.environ, "load")
    from test_action_contracts_integration import principal
    from test_context_memory_integration import DSN as context_dsn
    from test_context_memory_integration import publish
    from test_tip054_baseline_integration import DATABASE_DSN, synthetic_settings

    from rtr_copilot.config import get_settings
    from rtr_copilot.db.engine import runtime_engine, session_factory

    assert principal and publish  # Import dependency chain only; neither is called.
    assert context_dsn == DATABASE_DSN == DSN
    for settings in (get_settings(), synthetic_settings(tmp_path)):
        assert str(settings.postgres_dsn) == DSN
        assert settings.action_executor_enabled is True
        assert str(settings.action_workflow_dsn) == WORKFLOW
        assert (
            settings.rag_embedding_provider == "offline" and settings.rag_provider_mode == "local"
        )
        assert not settings.openai_api_key.get_secret_value()
        assert not settings.anthropic_api_key.get_secret_value()
        assert (
            settings.limits_rate_render_max,
            settings.limits_rate_default_read_max,
            settings.limits_rate_window_seconds,
            settings.action_executor_operation_timeout_seconds,
        ) == (5000, 5000, 60, 0.9)
    engine = runtime_engine()
    try:
        assert session_factory().kw["bind"] is engine
        pool = engine.sync_engine.pool
        assert pool.size() == 5 and pool._max_overflow == 5 and pool._pre_ping is True
        assert pool.checkedout() == 0 and pool.checkedin() == 0 and pool.overflow() == -5
        print("R21_ENVELOPE_PASS captured_DSN_cold_pool_no_SQL_no_seed_no_HTTP")
    finally:
        await engine.dispose()
